Traditional Chinese text is centered in the frame. The background is a pale yellow. (3) The woman is sitting on a piano bench, hands clasped in her lap. She looks directly at the camera with a calm expression. The background remains the wooden studio environment. (4) A close-up shot of the woman speaking. White chat bubbles containing text and small profile icons appear on the right side of the screen. Her facial expressions are animated and expressive. (5) The woman stands and adjusts her posture, gesturing broadly with her hands. More text-filled bubbles float around her head. The grand piano remains a central background object. (12) The woman is now in a black strapless gown, standing on a stage next to a grand piano. Rows of empty theater seats are visible in the background. (13) Closing graphic with a logo on a white background. Text indicates social media handles and further information. The framing is static and centered.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional advertisement for Teacher Chiang's online piano course. It effectively utilizes the teacher's professional and energetic persona to address common barriers to learning piano online, such as lack of guidance or difficulty levels. By showcasing specific curriculum highlights, student demonstrations, and diverse learning methods, it seeks to convince viewers of the course's value and accessibility.
